msg: Wendler question: would you add FSL 5x5 after the main sets?
Separate topic: how many run days per week?
Yes, FSL 5x5 works well after the main 5/3/1 sets. Use the first-set weight of your main lift for 5 sets of 5, and keep it a bit lighter if recovery is poor or the main sets were grinders.

For most people, 3 to 4 run days a week is a solid base. Add a fifth only if you can keep the easy runs easy and recover well. Keep one run a week as the quality session, and make the rest conversational.
